# Converted cards for the review-check tree tests

Real converted cards and their sidecars, copied unchanged from a whole-corpus conversion made at
commit `ae8e852d` (`python -m price_predictor convert`): Crashing Wave (an instant-or-sorcery spell
with no line), Lightning Bolt, Ranger Class, The Mightstone and Weakstone (a meld half), Binding the
Old Gods (a saga) and the Ajani's Pridemate token. The tests in
`tests/unit/scripts/test_gen3_review_checks.py` edit copies of them to build the failing cases.
